name: Rung-1 Phase 1 spec v0.1 revision
purpose: Revise Phase 1 after Item053 showed natural RG-hard solve-rate separation is significant only in the 9+ tail while paired communication and retraction efficiency gaps are robust across hard depths.

code_added_used.change: Defines Phase 1 v0.1 claim order, pool roles, node-cap sweep, Qwen one-shot anchor, RG-native lead-in generation, and operator-ladder metric refocus.
Registers and validates the Phase 1 v0.1 revision contract and spec invariants.
Adds the Phase 1 v0.1 spec and Item054 contract to the canonical ledger.

commands.command:
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from analysis.validate_outputs import validate_outputs
from analysis.experiment_log import generate_experiment_log
validate_outputs(); generate_experiment_log()
PY
commands.purpose: Regenerate validation and experiment ledger after adding the Phase 1 v0.1 spec.

provenance.verifier_api_required: reasoning_gym graph-color verifier or score_answer-compatible RG scoring

rows.claim: CBJ reduces inter-agent communication and retractions on natural RG-hard instances.
rows.metrics: comm_tokens,total_retractions paired per instance by depth
rows.pool: Item053 RG-native headline pool plus RG-native lead-in bins

rows.claim: Solve-rate advantage is budget-contingent and significant mainly at the deepest tail.
rows.pool: Item053 RG-native headline pool plus RG-native lead-in bins

rows.interpretation: Efficiency is primary; solve-vs-budget quantifies how recovery cost converts to solve under finite budget.

rows.reporting: not a headline baseline because reverse-greedy filtering makes it zero by construction
oneshot_llm_solve_rate and invalid rate by depth
rows.gate: if Qwen one-shot solves a large fraction, stop and choose harder substrate

rows.definition: Whether CBJ still reduces comm_tokens and total_retractions under fallible Qwen operators.
How far observed CBJ cost deviates from the symbolic cost line.
Operator error rates and spurious-backjump share explaining any efficiency-gap erosion.

rows.stop_condition: generation infeasible within declared rejection budget
Qwen solves a large fraction; switch to harder substrate

rows.action: Run symbolic efficiency curve and node-cap solve sweep.
Run Phase 1 P1a then P1b then P1c.
rows.stop_condition: efficiency gap erased or attributed to operator failure

honesty.does_not_establish: This is a planning/spec revision, not a new Phase 1 measurement. It does not establish Qwen one-shot hardness, node-cap budget curves, or fallible-operator efficiency-gap survival until those runs are executed.
honesty.item053_interpretation: Natural RG-hard solve gaps at depth 7 and 8 are recorded but not significant; the 9+ solve gap is significant; efficiency gaps are the primary Phase 1 target.
honesty.distribution_boundary: Item052 chain-planted rows are controlled stress isolation only and must not be mixed into the RG-native headline curve.

decision.next_step_routing: Run R4 RG-native lead-in generation for depths 4,5,6,exact 9, then R3 qwen_one_shot hardness anchor before node-cap symbolic sweeps and Phase 1 P1a/P1b/P1c.
